vona.volcanicActivitySummary: Vigorous lava fountaining within Halemaʻumaʻu crater with continuous effusion. Plume composed primarily of water vapor, sulfur dioxide (SO2), and intermittent Pele's hair and volcanic ash.

volcanicCloud.cloudCharacteristics: Volcanic smog (vog) plume drifting southwest under prevailing northeast trade wind conditions.

vona.remarks: Sulfur dioxide gas emission rates elevated at approximately 8,000 tonnes per day. Airborne particulate hazards localized downwind.
vona.nextNotice: Daily summary or immediately if hazard envelope expands.
